services.title: Auto repair
services.body: Vehicles are diagnosed and repaired at the actual fault before anything gets replaced.

reviews.author: Heidi Hartman
reviews.text: Needed our vehicle inspected, and found this shop. First I read reviews and found they received wonderful ones. This helped make my decision to visit them. The reviews were right. We were met with great customer service and our vehicle was inspected quickly. Highly recommend!

reviews.author: James Britt
reviews.text: Had faulty radiator on 2016 ram truck replaced. Don did an excellent job and work was done in a professional and timely manner. I will be a regular customer at this facility. Highly recommended. Very reasonable price.

reviews.author: Grouper Trooper
reviews.text: I went to another body shop to have a service done on my vehicle, and was told that my power steering pump and hoses were leaking. I didn’t have any liquid on the floor of my garage, so I thought that was kind of odd. I took my vehicle to Don’s automotive to have things checked, and there were no leaks to be found. I appreciate the care that Don’s took of my vehicle, and for cleaning up the mess the other body shop made. The other body shop had overfilled my fluid and spilled it everywhere. The other body shop had also told me to bring it back in so they could fix the leak. I appreciate Don’s Honesty about the leaks, not being found. They could very easily have said the pump and hoses were bad, but they didn’t. They cleaned my vehicle up very professionally, and the service fee was very reasonable. Honesty like this is hard to find and I appreciate Don’s for their honesty, integrity, and professionalism. Hats off to him and his son for helping me with my vehicle. I can’t recommend them enough for your auto needs.

reviews.author: Dan O'Shea
reviews.text: Needed an inspection done. Called and Don said no one was in line and I ran over there. The truck was looked at immediately and full state inspection done quickly and conveniently. Very happy customer! UPDATE: Took my car in, Don again had it looked at immediately for a full state inspection. The business doesn't disappoint!

reviews.author: Thomas Thompson
reviews.text: Had 4 tires bought and installed here to pass inspection! My aluminum rims are all scarred up.Theres a spot where he discolored the aluminum trying to buff out some of the gauges. He denied doing it. It's easy to scratch aluminum if you're not careful! What can you do?

reviews.author: Richard Trundy
reviews.text: I was told about Don's though a Parts and Auto stores in N. Myrtle Beach, SC. After giving them a call, I decided to give them a try. That was 2 years ago, and I trust these guy with all my family vehicles now. I have turned my friends and other family members on to their excellent work as well as pricing that can't be beat. They are a family owned business with old time values and upfront honesty.

reviews.author: Marisa Lomonico-Jones
reviews.text: After being recommended to another shop after failing my inspection for my muffler & waiting 2 weeks with no contact on their part, 2 calls by me and was told they cannot find parts needed for my Jeep anywhere. I decided to try Dons. Don set me up with an appointment first thing Monday morning, was able to order the part, have it delivered in less than 20 minutes & his son went right to work on it. I was in and out of there! I very much appreciated their hard work, honesty & great price! I absolutely will be making this my go to shop from now on, as well as recommending them to anyone who needs work done. 10/10 recommend! Thank you both again!

reviews.author: Lori Tupper
reviews.text: Just moved here and the best car mechanic shop! Honesty and great customer service. If you car needs repair, you won't find a better place.

reviews.author: JT Media
reviews.text: Had to do a last minute inspection to get a vehicle title transferred and this was all right near 5pm so was rushed and Don got us in quickly and had us back at the tag office in time, thanks again!

reviews.author: Abram Spencer
reviews.text: Never, Ever take your vehicle to this shop. I took my luxury vehicle her to get repaired and items were stolen off my vehicle and from inside of it. When I called to question them about where the items disappeared they said it was like that when I came in. This was the only shop that I had taken my vehicle to and all the items were there when I pulled up to there shop inside my vehicle and outside on the vehicle. I wish I could give them a zero. They never even fixed the problem to my vehicle just stole things from it. They could not repair it. Incompetent individuals!!!

reviews.author: Dumpster kliier fires again
reviews.text: Me and my girlfriend took both our vehicles to Dons , he fixed both in fact he went above n beyond and did a great job and he’s one of tge honest ones in tge area , some if the shops in tge area are crooks n liars , and cheating hard wrking pple , fir wrk that’s nit needed , go MR.Don your tge man !!!

reviews.author: Vanilla Dawg
reviews.text: I was lucky enough to find Don's automotive when I 1st moved here! Don and his team are very professional. Trustworthy. And make you feel like family. I would recommend him to anyone looking for work on their vehicles, he has given me such great prices with, great reliable service in such a timely manner! Even on day's I needed little things done and just stoped seeing if he has the time, or could i make an appointment, he's always got time ,if he can spare it, he truly cares , and when I told him thank yoy for being such an honest shop , his reply was " you're welcome, but i don't get return customer's by do people wrong," and he right, i will always take my vehicles here, Don and his team, 10 out of 10

reviews.author: Thomas “Nosleep Franky” Williams
reviews.text: I came in for a pre purchase inspection and Don handled it personally. He drove it , lifted it, was straight forward and done in less than 20 min, and fewer than 20 words. Need more guys like that around

reviews.author: Worshipleaderzach
reviews.text: Mr Spencer that reviewed luxury vehicle it was a older bmw by the way not in good shape nothing was taken from vehicle he called about hub cap I never touched I changed headlight trying to help the guy the whole inside of headlight wiring was melted I did my best to fix but ended up needing a new headlight that he wasn’t trying to pay for at the time nothing was stolen from the vehicle.

reviews.author: Ethan Banks
reviews.text: Don and his crew did an amazing job. They made accommodations to get me in when I was in a breakdown situation. I really appreciate these guys and would highly highly recommend. Just wanted to say thanks a lot.

reviews.author: Ashley Matthews
reviews.text: 12/3 3:00 p.m. Just had a terrible experience here. Came for inspection. Owner was very rude and seemed bothered to have a customer. Didn't greet me just looked at computer. Interrupted me when I asked a question. Shop and waiting area was very dirty as well. Walked out and made an appointment for inspection tomorrow somewhere else.

reviews.author: Annette Brewer
reviews.text: Exceptional service! I am very thankful to have used Don's Automotive for the 1st time while down at our 2nd home in Holden Beach. I unfortunately had my car break down on this past memorial day near Don's shop. As a walk in customer, I was greeted very politely. Don was quick to assess the issue. Due to the holiday, there were no rental car companies open. Don and staff were able to think outside the box and get us back up and running within just a couple of hours. This is a efficient, no nonsense shop. I would highly recommend this shop, very pleased with the service.

reviews.author: Jessica Goins
reviews.text: I took my 03 Ford Explorer to L&A South Tire and Auto because my vehicle was overheating and they had previously done work on my water pump and hoses. They replaced a bad clam and the very next day I had to take it back it was still overheating. They told me I had a cracked block and it was going to cost $8,000 to fix it. As a single full time daddy I had no idea how I was going to fix or get another vehicle and we were without transportation for a month. Something told me to get a second opinion so I took it to Don. All it needed was a new radiator and he fixed it immediately for a very reasonable price. I am so pleased with his service and care of his customers. I highly recommend him for anything you need under his services. My life is back on track now thanks to Don. Thanks again Don!! - Mike Meadows

reviews.author: Kirk Parrish
reviews.text: Don was very kind and helpful. He was fair and honest. We were on vacation and needed help. He stayed in contact, fit us in his busy schedule promptly, and explained the situation clearly. I highly recommend Don't Automtive!

reviews.author: Andrea White
reviews.text: Don was great! He explained everything that was wrong with my car and was able to fix it in a timely manner despite having to find the parts for it that were not readily available. Being a woman, and not knowing that much about cars, I went in skeptical about being taken advantage of my lack of knowledge. He definitely put my mind at ease and was very affordable. Thank you for the great service!

reviews.author: Julie Torres
reviews.text: Very reasonable pricing. Don is very knowledgeable and does excellent work. My mother in law told me I should try this place because she doesn't trust anyone else with her vehicle. I now understand why. Nice guy, straightforward, and trustworthy.

reviews.author: Brittany Bentley
reviews.text: I went to Dons for an inspection. I was charged almost $200 for a single USED tire. I'm not a mechanic however I do know that you are not supposed to change just ONE TIRE. My car was there for 3 days to change one tire. I may be a woman, but I am not an idiot nor will I be taken advantage of. My money spends just like anyone else's and it will be spent elsewhere from now on.

reviews.author: Freddie Lipata
reviews.text: Had to leave my car in the area after some engine trouble. Looked up local repair shops and the reviews and replies from the owner brought me in. Loved my experience with Don’s Automotive. Dropped my car off and they saw me starting to walk to my ride 2 miles away and they had one of their friends catch up to me and give me a ride back to the car. They called me with the diagnosis/price and gave me a heads up that they might have to replace the coils if it was damaged. Gave them the green light. I called before leaving Charleston to make sure it was ready for pickup and it was a smooth transaction when I got there. Car was ready and was in and out in less than 10 minutes. They could’ve just went ahead and changed the coils and make the additional money, but told me that they checked them out and that they’re still good. Would definitely come back if I ever have car problems in the area. Read the reviews on google and read the replies to the bad reviews. Can’t take the word of bad customers.

reviews.author: candace phelps
reviews.text: This week was first time I used Don's Automotive and I am very satisfied that he fixed my 2002 ford mustang gt. I will be a returning customer if need be. I will recommend Don to everyone I know. Good people, and very friendly and they make sure everything is right with your vehicle.

reviews.author: Clark Stern
reviews.text: A glorious godsend of a repair shop, on the long lonely journey between Myrtle Beach and Wilmington. My car had a very small, but very bridling, sudden problem on US 17, and Don & his men were able to diagnose and then replace the part lickety-split, with efficiency, kindness, and expertise, all for a very reasonable cost. This is like the best long-gone little out-of-the-way repair shops of my youth (back when I drove cars that were always breaking down), with a well-worn interior, and a family-run atmosphere that makes you feel confident in the service, and glad that you're not at a sterile behemoth national chain.

reviews.author: Heather McIntyre
reviews.text: We were in town for summer vacation when our A/C went out. Don and his team really took care of us. They were able to get everything fixed and we had our car back the next day. The price was fair and the service was excellent. My little girls really appreciate having the A/C back. Thank you Don.

reviews.author: Fred Bowman
reviews.text: While on vacation to Holden Beach the AC on our Toyota van suddenly began squealing loudly. Don and his mechanics worked our van into their schedule and quickly analyzed the problem. The belt tension adjustment had backed off. He could have easily charged us for a complete AC overhaul and we would not have known the difference. Quality and honest work is hard to find these days. I highly recommend Don and his shop for all your automotive needs.

reviews.author: Ashley Maroon
reviews.text: Stopped by today to get an Inspection (State Inspection) on my Explorer. Don and his staff were friendly and professional. They worked me in without having an appointment and I was on my way back to enjoy the Beach. We're fortunate to have local business people like Don, I used him many times in the past and he always been great to work with and does outstanding work. When I have a problem with one of vechicles when I'm at my home in Ocean Isle he's the first person I think of. Thanks Don, keep up the great service.

reviews.author: Kenna Murray
reviews.text: I never let anyone else work on my car. I'd recommend his business to anyone. I've never felt over priced. He listens and explains the problem. His wife runs the front and is very friendly, experienced, and patient.

reviews.author: Amber Dickey
reviews.text: My family and I were on vacation to Ocean Isle Beach in September 2017. Halfway through our vacation, our drive side window would not go back up. We tried everything, except ripping the door apart, and nothing helped. We decided to see if we could borrow some tools from a local mechanic, and the local gas station recommended Don's Automotive. The staff was super friendly. They got our car fixed, and ready to go in roughly 15 minutes. They were so helpful, and saved us from worrying about rain on our trip!! I highly recommend this place. You won't be unhappy!!

reviews.author: Stephanie Zaleta
reviews.text: Update: 3 years later, I find myself living back in Shallotte, and Don may be busy busy busy but that's what you get when you're the best shop in town! He still got me in and out on in a 20-minute inspection with others waiting! Waste no time or money elsewhere, go see Don! FANTASTIC shop!! Honest mechanic who will not nickel and dime you, he will tell you straight forward what needs to be done and will get the work done, and done right, he will even take the time to chat car parts, work, and diagnosis with the customer to make sure you understand what the issue is and how he is fixing it. I had my well taken care of 00 Acura Integra at 2 different shops in the area and they both missed a simple diagnosis of a bad distributor even after a tune-up, changing the distributor rotor and cap, as well as a catalytic convertor. I was still having problems and misfiring after almost $800 in work elsewhere so I brought my car to Don's to look over the warranty work done by another TechNet shop and he found the problem in no time, ordered the parts, and had it fixed and running like the day I bought the car with 70k miles on it. It has 173k miles on it now and is running like the champion it has always been. Stand up mechanic that I would highly suggest if you don't want to be messed around by a local shop with a surgical style waiting rooms who overbook and turn and burn cars with costly overhead to drive up the labor expenses. I will be coming to Don's for all my mechanical needs from here on out. Thank you, Don!!!!

reviews.author: Carol Johnson
reviews.text: As two damsels in distress, I’d like to give a shout out to Don’s Automotive. We were headed home from OIB when my car started acting up. At first it was making a buzzing sound then the electronic power steering system warning light came on. Next thing I know the car wouldn’t hold a charge and we were stuck. Don was slammed but said if we could have the car towed, he would do his best to get us back on the road in a timely fashion. In his mind he knew that replacing the alternator should took care of my problem and it did. He and his wife Silvia bent over backwards that day to help us and I was extremely grateful. I highly recommend this independent, family business for good service, reasonable pricing and honesty! Thank you again!

reviews.author: Rhonda Kurtz
reviews.text: Stopped in for a routine state inspection and we were promptly helped. We were in and out in 25 minutes. It is located about 1 mile from DMV so we were able to go and get our tag renewal sticker. Don, the owner is a gentleman and very polite. You should consider Don's Automotive.

reviews.author: Aaron McManus
reviews.text: Top notch! Had my truck at another garage for a week. The other garage was rude and after a week still had made no progress on my truck. Don's was friendly and had my truck completely fixed in half a day. I will be using Don's Automotive indefinitely. Thanks for the awesome service

reviews.author: Lee Buchholz
reviews.text: When my AC started screeching, I figured it would cost a thousand or more. I met with Don and watched him call 5 or 6 different parts houses trying to find a specific part that could potentially save me hundreds. Couldn't find any. As we talked he said let me try one other place. So glad he did. He found the simple replacement part that saved me over $800. He could have very easily done a total replacement and I would not have known it could be done that way. After this experience I am convinced Don is in the business because he enjoys what he does and the money made is a benefit of his love of vehicles. Especially Mustangs!! Thanks Don, I'll be back

reviews.author: Jay Gordon
reviews.text: Was in NC on vacation and my brakes were starting to fail. Don's put me on their schedule and replaced a corroded brake line for a reasonable price. Since I can't be a regular customer I'm posting this review in appreciation of Don's fixing my brakes without jerking me around.

reviews.author: Brett Riggs
reviews.text: I have a 1996 Ford Bronco I've had for almost 30 years, and like any ride that old, it has issues. Many guys don't want to or don't know how to fix old stuff like that. Don kept it for a few days, called me every afternoon, and told me what he had done and what needed to be done. Fixed a lot of the engine problems and got her running. That's more than I've gotten from a lot of mechanics. So he'll be getting my business again.

reviews.author: Pat McGee
reviews.text: We had an issue with our van when traveling to Ocean Isle. Don's took care of us quickly and efficiently. If we lived in the area, I would use him to service all of our vehicles. Thanks

reviews.author: Denzil Antonio
reviews.text: Unfortunately this was our 3rd time visiting Don's shop. Twice for AC repair and another for a diagnostic advice for noise coming from the back of our vehicle. All repairs were handled efficiently and at a fair price and as a result we have referred 5 families to Don's shop for similar problems and they have all received the same excellent service.

reviews.author: G Jonas
reviews.text: We broke down while on vacation. Don was honest and couldn't get us back on the road in time . So refered us to Best Bet Automotive. We appreciate the honesty and being so helpful.

reviews.author: Felisha Cavazos
reviews.text: Can’t recommend this place enough! Don was super helpful and able to provide some clarity to what was going on with my car during a trip from out of town. He was able to fit us in the same day we called and we are so appreciative!

reviews.author: Donna R Tivoli
reviews.text: Went in for an inspection for my car. Not only was Don quick in getting the job done, his prices were a great surprise. I will be using his service in the future.

reviews.author: Jennie Trantham
reviews.text: Had to give 1 star to post this but would have given 0. I had an appointment this morning at this shop and the mechanic Don was very disrespectful, aggressive with anger toward me. He yelled at me stating he was only going to be receiving $10.00 for the oil change. I was so upset because he yelled at me so I walked out and I would NEVER recommend this shop to anyone!!!!!!!!!! This was the WORST customer service in my life. I WILL recommend Joe's and Moe's Auto Repair and they will treat you with outstanding customer service!!!!!

reviews.author: Bill Davis
reviews.text: I recently had Don's Automotive replace a clutch in my Mustang Cobra. They did a fine job at a reasonable price. About two weeks later, the transmission in my car wouldn't shift into 2nd or 4th. This had absolutely nothing to do with the work Don's Automotive had done and I thought the syncros had gone bad. So I brought the car by their shop and Don himself looked at it and in two minutes told me it was just an adjustment on the shifter and that there was nothing wrong with the transmission. He made the adjustments in another two minuets time and didn't charge me. If you want good, honest service and prices, go see Don's. I know I will next time.

reviews.author: Phyllis Howard
reviews.text: Our alternator went out while we were on vacation. We went to Don’s Automotive for the repair. They were able to fix us up and get us back on the road by the next morning so we could continue our time at the beach. Thanks for saving the day guys! Y’all are awesome!

reviews.author: Jessica Datillo
reviews.text: Don has always been honest and upfront with his work. I have been going to him exclusively for years and feel confident that I'm dealing with a trustworthy business- something that can't be said for all mechanics unfortunately.

reviews.author: John Austin
reviews.text: I was on vacation in Sunset Beach and discovered a fuel line leak. Don's Automotive fixed it the same day with a great price. Great folks. They even have a pool table.

reviews.author: S Schroed
reviews.text: The most lowlife person ever. Expected me, or should I say him, to drive my nice car over the 8” drop in the so called driveway. I didn’t want that so he walked away. Beware anyone with half a brain using this dump the office smells like an ashtray and again the owner Don is below the lowest level of a professional ever.

reviews.author: Eddie Fitz
reviews.text: Solid straight shooters. Very knowledgeable about cars/trucks. I have found my new service place. Good guys. Quick too!

reviews.author: Brent Dooley
reviews.text: My Odyssey broke down while on vacation, alternator died. Shop had me up and running in 2-3 hours! Very honest and reasonabley priced.

reviews.author: Richard Holden
reviews.text: Took my truck to Don because of a/c problems. Don did an awesome job of getting the problems resolved quickly and affordable. I do highly recommend having Don as your go to mechanic.

reviews.author: Melissa Henson
reviews.text: Always dependable and honest but my last experience at Don's automotive was above and beyond. I can't thank them enough for all their help.

reviews.author: Ken Hedrick
reviews.text: Don is a a guy who is old school. He believes in a hand shake on a service and follows thru. I Will be back.

reviews.author: Christie Marek
reviews.text: I’ve had inspections done before with them with no problem but when I send my son after early release (1:18 pm) and they say “we aren’t doing anymore inspections today” WOW!!!!! I’ll never do business with them again!!!

reviews.author: Samantha Hickman
reviews.text: This place is amazing. By far the best and really goes above and beyond. Makes me know we are safe driving our car. Prices are cheaper than others around.

reviews.author: john schricker
reviews.text: Don was great. We broke down on our vacation and he had us back on the road in no time. I highly recommend using them. Thanks again Don

reviews.author: lisette night
reviews.text: I did not do business with this place. However I spoke to the staff and he was very kind and very helpful. Even offered to get me a phone number for another place. Would definitely try them in the future.

reviews.author: Arnold Boring
reviews.text: Had to evacuate for a hurricane from a barrier island. Had an exhaust problem that he was able to remedy with some ingenuity. There aren't many mechanic's like this anymore. Definitely reccomend.

reviews.author: Stephanie Smith
reviews.text: Very professional and very hardworking. Don and his employees are great people. I will continue to cometo dons automotive for all of my needs. Thank you guys.

reviews.author: Like it Or Not
reviews.text: Great customer service. Work is excellent. Don is the man. Oh and he charges extra for whining or a high pitched cry haha

reviews.author: Timothy Turner
reviews.text: I always give credit where credit is due a good old-fashioned smile and a handshake honest hard work I recommend them highly. Thanks for the hard work. Rabbi€

reviews.author: ReD Bud8
reviews.text: Great shop to get your vehicle in working order, Don is honest and fair.. not many mechanics like Don left.. trust him with all your vehicle needs..

reviews.author: Joshua Parrott
reviews.text: Talked with Don . He answered all my questions and he will be my go to for keeping my 20 year old car on the road.

reviews.author: John H
reviews.text: Most honest mechanic around! Great work done right. Don's fixes the problem right at the best price. Thanks Don!

reviews.author: Dawn Beddard
reviews.text: They were very nice,they did the job quickly, and the fact that they guaranteed their work is awesome!

reviews.author: j madri
reviews.text: The woman on the phone was very rude she has to take some Costner service classes..a little respect would go along way... That's why I took my car some where else..

reviews.author: Philly Phreak
reviews.text: Said he couldn't help because he was about to close because all his help went home. Then stood outside door for 20 min.

reviews.author: James Ronald Bellamy Jr
reviews.text: Great service; fast and efficient, with just the right amount of friendliness and customer service that makes you want to come back!!

reviews.author: Damita Gould
reviews.text: I like him ..he really help me when Noone else could fix my flex and my Jetta. I told him he was worth his weight in gold. Very happy with DON ' AUTOMOTIVE..HIGHLY RECOMMENDED
